title: 第9664章 阵营所在第9663章 祸乱之子
content_zh:
这凭空出现的东西乍一看四四方方的，呈现一种白色，似乎是一个普普通通的白板。
其上也没有任何特殊的波动，没有任何的不同寻常，似乎是路边随意可见的东西。
“这就是母亲让我得到的那本书……”
“但究竟是什么，到现在我也不知道。”
王明阳缓缓开口。
而冉伟的目光已经紧紧落在了那白板上。
“东西应该不会错，你母亲让你带回来的东西，只有你能带回来，因为这是你们母子血脉链接的特殊性。”
“但这本书，对于如今的阵营来说，也有着巨大的作用。”
“同样，可能需要你……”
唰!
冉伟的话还没说完，只见王明阳这里，竟然直接把手中的白板就这么朝着冉伟给扔了过来。
冉伟下意识的一把接住，神情都有些意外。
而王明阳那里，却是诚恳的开口道:“冉家主，既然我和灵爷爷来了，选择了回到阵营之中，选择去见我母亲，那么这本书，自然就要交给阵营。”
“这也是昔日母亲留下的话，我身为人子，自然要说到做到。”
“但我唯一的请求是，与我母亲有关的昔日那些人，他们还好吗?”
“如果可以的话，我希望他们都能好好的活着，不要因为我或者我母亲的原因……”
王明阳的声音带上了一丝请求。
这一下子，冉伟的神情也变得郑重与肃然。
“明阳，你放心，你遵照昔日的约定而来，完成了你该完成的，做到了你该做到的，那么阵营一定会履行约定。”
“我代表玄派，一定会帮你促成这件事。”

看得出来，冉伟对于王明阳所表现出来的气度与成熟，发自内心的欣赏。
“多谢冉家主。”
王明阳感激开口。
“冉家主，你说阵营内有不止一个派系不希望我们活着回到阵营内。”
“那么，在南部区域我们遇到的截杀，以及来到了春岚城遇到的那陈雄，是不是就是……”一直沉默的灵墨轩此时缓缓开口，语气带上了一丝犀利。
冉伟并不意外灵墨轩的询问，反而立刻回答道:“现在看来是这样的，那几个派系显然是派了人过来，想要一劳永逸。”
“但，没有任何的证据，他们做事，必定手尾干净。”
“根据目前所有的情况，八大派系之中，宇派，洪派是早就明牌对你母亲不喜，甚至敌对。”
“至于剩下的还有没有一两个，不好说。”
“至于陈雄和他女儿，他们是出自于黄派的。”
“只不过，我倒是可以明确的告诉你们，陈雄这个货所在的黄派，反而不会是针对和敌对你和你母亲的派系，属于中立。”
此话一出，王明阳与灵墨轩都有些意外。
“那么请问冉家主您所在的玄派呢?看起来，您这一派似乎与我母亲关系还行?”王明阳突然这般开口。
“这就涉及到昔日我玄派与天派的情况了。”
“我玄派上一任的支柱级，与你母亲所在的天派上一任支柱级，也就是你母亲的师父，乃是真正的生死之交，关系莫逆。”
“所以，天派与玄派之间，一直都是坚定的盟友，即便已经过去了漫长岁月，情谊依旧在。”
“或者说得再现实一点……”
content_en:
At first glance, this thing that appeared out of thin air looked boxy and white, and seemed to be an ordinary whiteboard.
There are no special fluctuations on it, nothing unusual, it seems to be something that can be seen casually on the roadside.
"This is the book my mother asked me to get..."
"But what it is, I still don't know."
Wang Mingyang spoke slowly.
And Ran Wei's eyes were already firmly fixed on the white board.
"There should be nothing wrong with the things. Only you can bring back the things your mother asked you to bring back, because this is the special nature of the blood link between your mother and son."
"But this book also has a huge effect on today's camp."
"Similarly, you may be needed..."
Whoosh!
Before Ran Wei finished speaking, Wang Mingyang threw the whiteboard in his hand towards Ran Wei.
Ran Wei subconsciously caught it, looking a little surprised.
But Wang Mingyang said sincerely: "Master Ran, since Grandpa Ling and I are here and have chosen to return to the camp and see my mother, then naturally this book must be handed over to the camp."
"These are also the words left by my mother in the past. As a son of man, I naturally have to do what I say."
"But my only request is, are the people involved with my mother from the past, are they OK?"
"If possible, I hope they can all live well, not because of me or my mother..."
Wang Mingyang's voice contained a hint of request.
Suddenly, Ran Wei's expression became solemn and awe-inspiring.
"Mingyang, don't worry. You came in compliance with the agreement in the past, completed what you were supposed to accomplish, and did what you were supposed to do. Then the camp will definitely honor the agreement."
"On behalf of the Xuan Sect, I will definitely help you facilitate this matter."
It can be seen that Ran Wei appreciates Wang Mingyang's magnanimity and maturity from the bottom of his heart.
"Thank you very much, Master Ran."
Wang Mingyang spoke gratefully.
"Master Ran, you said that there is more than one faction in the camp that does not want us to return to the camp alive."
"So, the interception we encountered in the southern region, and the Chen Xiong we met when we came to Chunlan City, are they..." Lingmoxuan, who had been silent all this time, slowly spoke at this time, with a hint of sharpness in his tone.
Ran Wei was not surprised by Lingmo Xuan's inquiry, but immediately replied: "It seems like this now. Those factions obviously sent people here to solve the problem once and for all."
"But, without any evidence, they must be doing things with clean hands."
"According to all the current circumstances, among the eight major factions, the Yu faction and the Hong faction have long made it known that they are not happy with your mother and are even hostile to her."
"As for whether there are one or two left, it's hard to say."
"As for Chen Xiong and his daughter, they are from the Huang faction."
"However, I can tell you clearly that the Huang faction that this guy Chen Xiong belongs to is not a faction that is targeting or hostile to you and your mother. It is neutral."
When these words came out, both Wang Mingyang and Ling Moxuan were a little surprised.
"So, Master Ran, what about your Xuan sect? It seems that your sect has a good relationship with my mother?" Wang Mingyang said suddenly.
"This involves the situation between our Xuan Sect and Tian Sect in the past."
"The previous pillar level of my Xuan sect and the previous pillar level of your mother's Tian sect, that is, your mother's master, are true life-and-death friends. We have an irreversible relationship."
"So, the Tian sect and the Xuan sect have always been firm allies. Even though a long time has passed, the friendship is still there."
"Or to be more realistic..."
